## Summary

Describe the change and the motivation behind it. Link any related issue.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New rule or check
- [ ] New or changed fixer
- [ ] CLI or output change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or internal cleanup

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for this change.
- [ ] `bunx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
- [ ] `bun test` passes.
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` or others) when behavior or flags change.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
